t: What Merchant Marine Is All About
title: What Merchant Marine Is All About
description: Merchant mariners crew the commercial ships carrying world trade: deckhands, mates, engineers, and captains working months-long voyages. They stand watches, handle cargo, maintain the ship, and drill for emergencies. Container ships, tankers, bulk carriers, tugs and barges, ferries, and offshore supply vessels. Deep-sea, inland, and Great Lakes sectors each have their own rhythms. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.

title: History and Evolution
